limits: Stop this cold Python parser/rewriter cost profile. Exact whole-elementary-stream capability is demonstrated only for fixed mapping, one CELT20ms frame per component, shared source/priming, and zero gain; not half-pair extraction, arbitrary packets, independently primed sources, or production integration.
